mapping.audience: Native SDK naming intent on model properties and operation parameters, ARM and data-plane; measured corpus is ARM only.

comparisonProfile.defaultActivation: Separate configured-mode controls, not inferred from the full run.
comparisonProfile.suppression: Authored source suppressions retained; no exhaustive pre-suppression capture.
comparisonProfile.swaggerVersionPolicy: Latest emitted version retained by the production ARM baseline.
comparisonProfile.typeSpecVersionPolicy: Unprojected source program; no emitted-path matching.

claims.behavior: Report no-effect property and operation-parameter overrides.
Keep missing overrides, real renames, and case-only renames.
Wire-name differences alone do not justify ineffective SDK naming.
Preserve meaningful scoped resets and exact policy; report repeated fallback overrides.
additionalUnitBehavior: Copied properties with independently authored overrides

claims.behavior: Use actual friendly fallback and preserve dependent friendly-source naming effects.
claims.contextBoundary: The emitter-independent lint uses TCGC's default friendly-source naming policy. Actual SDK contexts continue honoring use-client-name-for-friendly-name-source=false; direct resolver tests cover both settings.

claims.behavior: Report one warning per authored removable application, retaining independently authored applications.
Honor authored suppression through the registered rule.
Target-only comparison actually activates the packed rule, without claiming defaults were assessed.
Keep the new rule off the three central default presets.

validationProfile.scopeAuthority: Explicit user changed-test-file scope, followed by one specifically approved same-three-file maxWorkers=1 diagnostic.
validationProfile.historicalTimeoutCause: Unproven; both preceding mixed test/hook failures remain failed receipts.
validationProfile.fullOwningPackageSuite: Not required under the superseding user changed-file profile; not claimed as passed.

portableInjectedControls.inapplicableReason: Pinned candidate does not register unrelated resource-group-path-parameter; its six fixtures were excluded prospectively.

semanticLimits: No extension-based, AutoRest-simulation, or emitted-Swagger predicate in production rule logic.
Native SDK no-effect semantics intentionally differ from strict extension-to-wire/source-key equality.
Exact-name policy, scoped fallback, friendly names, and authored-copy multiplicity prevent blanket count or semantic equivalence claims.
No complete SDK or data-plane population was measured.
No fuzzy or name-only source-to-Swagger correspondence is claimed.
